name: file_move
description: Move or rename one workspace-relative regular file to a new workspace-relative path that does not exist yet. Optional create_dirs=true creates the destination parent chain. The file keeps its mode and ownership. Fails with conflict if the destination exists.

path.description: Workspace-relative source file. Must be a regular file.

create_dirs.description: If true, mkdir -p the destination parent chain. Default false.
